material_states.name: Prepare oleylamine reactor with two addition funnels, Claisen adapter and cold trap
Dissolve lithium silylamide in anhydrous toluene; load first funnel
Load second funnel with1M DIBAL in THF
Heat oleylamine under vacuum at140°C for1.5h
Cool to50°C and add anhydrous SnCl2 under nitrogen stream
Seal system and heat at110°C under vacuum for30min
Backfill with nitrogen and heat to180°C
Apply mild vacuum, then close vacuum valve before opening addition funnel
Open first funnel to inject lithium silylamide solution
After10s delay inject DIBAL solution from second funnel
At50°C add chloroform and oleic acid, then precipitate with ethanol
Redissolve in chloroform and oleic acid; precipitate with ethanol
Disperse in a nonpolar solvent; exact identity and volume not specified

operations.description: 2L three-neck reactor, condenser,5cm elliptic stirrer600–900rpm; Claisen adapter between reactor and condenser; cold trap above condenser. Mainp5 mentions four-neck flask only as optional alternative, not the used setup. Mainp2 uses50cm double-wall reflux condenser; TableS1 lists >50cm overall condenser height, internal cooling coil, elliptic50mm×20mm stirrer and2L three-neck flask. Dimensions are source annotations, not a scale drawing. Mainp2 requires supported reactor and source-limited thermal-difference precautions; no new apparatus specification supplied.
